title: AXON..
features: Fullscreen native WebGL2 particle torus: 262,144 desktop / 16,384 mobile particles, float-texture ping-pong positions, 256px GPU velocity field with curl/vorticity/divergence/five pressure iterations/gradient subtraction/advection and 512px density. Pointer/touch stirring, elastic recovery, gaze, ten working category chips, four animated original study previews and responsive research UI.
limitations: Native WebGL2 replaces CDN Three.js. An original parametric twisted torus replaces the optional neural SDF; particle target spring and analytic curl approximate surface projection. Initial random scatter is seeded near the torus for a recognizable first frame. Local animated Canvas study previews replace unlicensed remote videos, so no remote video HTTP claims are made. WebGL2 and EXT_color_buffer_float are required; a clear fallback message appears otherwise.
